text.p: - The collision of a Kazakh Il-76 cargo plane and a Saudi Boeing-747, the cause of which is still unknown, has once again raised the issue of the safety of planes built in the former Soviet Union.
- Results of a tender on Agroprombank, one of Russia's biggest banks, will determine who will finance the country's agriculture and how it will be done.

- Belarussian President Alexander Lukashenko wants greater integration with Russia and more Russian gas. During his one-day visit to Moscow he managed to meet leaders of the Russian government, the parliament and the head of the Gazprom gas giant.
- Alexander Lukashenko's speech in the Russian parliament lacked any sensations, although he strongly advocated the benefits of close integration between the two countries .

- The president's daughter, Tatyana Dyachenko, Kremlin chief of staff Anatoly Chubais and a group of wealthy businessmen are ruling the country, the paper says, basing its conclusion on a review of the foreign press.
- Russia's north is on the verge of catastrophe. A lack of the fuel needed to survive the long winter may force people to abandon their homes.
